svg.text: Fig 11.1: the Application uses ConcreteImpl through the Service interface; to create instances without a source dependency on ConcreteImpl it calls makeSvc on the
ServiceFactory interface, implemented by ServiceFactoryImpl, which instantiates ConcreteImpl and returns it as a Service. The curved line is an architectural boundary
between abstract and concrete: all source dependencies cross it in one direction, toward the abstract side.
Flow of control crosses the line the opposite way, so source dependencies are inverted against control flow: Dependency Inversion. It returns as the architectural
